lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters in multiple horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with spots increasing in diameter toward the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, light above and shadow below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a high density of small, high-luminance spots across its visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white linear marking is present on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin.
